source_state.scope: Current isolated Goal worktree with the 20-WP implementation changes and the corrected deployment-only .vercelignore.
source_state.reproducibility: The exact deployment ID is authoritative for the uploaded source; the base commit alone is not presented as the deployed snapshot.
source_state.snapshot_limitation: No content manifest was preserved at upload time. Later worktree hashes must not be presented as the deployed snapshot, so this deployment cannot prove acceptance of a reviewed source revision.

environment_preflight.detail: Build-time preflight reported required names and staging isolation assertions present; no values were read or recorded.
environment_preflight.payment_boundary: Staging payment still uses the configured PayUni flow and is outside this isolation proof.

packaging.repair: Excluded root-only local .next outputs, orchestration receipts, and host-only paths through .vercelignore.

superseded_deployment.defect: An unanchored reports/ ignore rule omitted the nested api/funnel/operations/reports route from the deployment archive.

packaging.verification_scope: The repaired deployment is READY and its remote output contains both api/funnel/operations/reports and api/funnel/operations/reports.rsc. A full local-to-remote route manifest comparison was not preserved, so archive completeness beyond the repaired route is not claimed.

alias_inventory.listing_completeness: The CLI returned no matching alias for either exact deployment hostname; the deployments were subsequently removed, so alias absence is no longer a live safety dependency.
alias_inventory.policy: Neither deployment may be assigned an alias or used as a scheduler target. Both were removed after evidence collection.

http_verification.classification: Every response from the corrected deployment carried X-Vercel-Mitigated: deny and an hkg1 Vercel request region, so the Vercel edge denied it before a verified application response. The exact mitigation rule could not be identified because read-only firewall overview returned plan permission error 402. No runtime route was marked PASS.

local_link_cleanup.detail: Vercel CLI created .env.local and .vercel link metadata while linking for the read-only firewall query. The env file contents were never read or output. Both the generated env file and the verified in-worktree .vercel directory were removed.
